summary: The taskforce will inform our long-term approach to harmonising transaction and post-trade reporting requirements across UK Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation (UK MiFIR), UK European Market Infrastructure Regulation (UK EMIR) and UK Securities Financing Transactions Regulation (UK SFTR). content: The Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of England have appointed members to the Transaction and Post-trade Reporting Harmonisation Taskforce. The initiative aims to inform the long-term approach to harmonising reporting requirements across key regulatory frameworks, including UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and UK SFTR. The taskforce is organized into three separate working groups to address these regulatory standards.

title: FCA censures Equity for Growth (Securities) Limited
summary: EFG approved financial promotions which failed to disclose very high commission fees charged by its appointed representatives and other introducers for marketing the minibonds to investors. Appointed representatives carry out regulated activities under the responsibility of an authorised firm, known as ‘the principal’. The promotions... Read More
content: The Financial Conduct Authority has censured Equity for Growth (Securities) Limited due to failures in its financial promotions. The firm approved marketing materials for minibonds that omitted crucial disclosures regarding very high commission fees charged by appointed representatives and introducers. The FCA highlighted that principals are responsible for the regulated activities and promotions carried out under their authorization.

title: FCA advances package of equity market transparency reforms
summary: The package confirms the framework for a future equity consolidated tape, consults on targeted market structure reforms and introduces an interim market activity reporting tool for shares.  UK equity markets offer investors a wide choice of trading options. content: The Financial Conduct Authority has advanced a new package of equity market transparency reforms. This initiative confirms the framework for a future equity consolidated tape, consults on targeted market structure reforms, and introduces an interim market activity reporting tool for shares to support competition and investor choice in UK equity markets.

title: FCA finalises rules to cut firms’ transaction reporting costs by over £100m a year
summary: Transaction reports are critical to the FCA’s ability to detect and investigate market abuse, monitor market functioning and supervise firms effectively. content: The Financial Conduct Authority has finalized new rules aimed at reducing firms' transaction reporting costs by over 100 million pounds annually. The updated regulations are designed to maintain the collection of accurate, high-quality data necessary for detecting market abuse and supervising firms effectively, while removing duplicative and low-value reporting requirements.

title: Tribunal upholds FCA ban on pair involved in pension transfer advice and reduces fines
summary: The Tribunal agreed that both acted dishonestly by providing a backdated appointed representative agreement to the FCA. The Tribunal found that Ms Dunne falsely claimed she had given advice to some pension schemes before she had done so. Also, that she had failed to take... Read More
content: A tribunal has upheld the FCA's ban on two individuals involved in pension transfer advice, while also reducing their financial penalties. The tribunal concluded that both acted dishonestly by submitting a backdated appointed representative agreement to the regulator. Additionally, findings showed that one of the individuals falsely claimed to have provided advice to certain pension schemes prematurely and failed to meet regulatory expectations.

content: The Financial Conduct Authority has introduced simplified IPO rules designed to strengthen the UK listings market and improve its ability to compete globally. The reforms aim to decrease execution risk for issuers and reduce compliance expenses, creating a more accessible environment for companies seeking public market entry.
